record.name: Plaid
record.one_liner: Financial technology platform that builds APIs connecting bank accounts to apps.
record.access_note: Sign up for a developer account on the Plaid Dashboard for free sandbox and trial access.
record.api_note: The Plaid API covers authentication, accounts, balances, transactions, investments, liabilities, and payments.

evidence.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret.
Start with our month-to-month plan: unlimited usage, no commitments upfront—only pay for what you use.
The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP. Requests are POST requests, and responses are JSON
The Dashboard MCP server is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid.
